mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_pe_prompt (id, name, model, model_config, task_id, source, type, question, answer, variables, manual_score, creator, updater, workspace_id, file_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{model}, #{modelConfig, typeHandler=com.openjiuwen.studio.prompt.engineering.mapper.handler.ModelConfigHandler}, #{taskId}, #{source}, #{type}, #{question}, #{answer}, #{variables}, #{manualScore}, #{creator}, #{updater}, #{workspaceId}, #{fileId});
mapper.update: update t_pe_prompt t set t.name = #{name}, t.model = #{model}, t.model_config = #{modelConfig, typeHandler=com.openjiuwen.studio.prompt.engineering.mapper.handler.ModelConfigHandler}, t.type = #{type}, t.question = #{question}, t.answer = #{answer}, t.variables = #{variables}, t.manual_score = #{manualScore}, t.updater = #{updater}, t.file_id = #{fileId} where t.id = #{id} and t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId}

update t_pe_prompt
manual_score = #{smallPrompt.manualScore},
name = #{smallPrompt.name},
updated_on = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
where id = #{smallPrompt.id} and workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.delete: delete from t_pe_prompt where id = #{promptId} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
delete from t_pe_prompt where task_id = #{taskId} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.select: SELECT variables from t_pe_prompt where task_id = #{taskId} and type = 1 AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
select count(1) from t_pe_prompt where task_id = #{taskId} and type = 1 AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
SELECT 1 FROM t_pe_prompt WHERE id = #{promptId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId} LIMIT 1
